fields.why: Table 1 gives a p-value for each age, race/ethnicity and income level against a stated referent group, and Table 2 tests ages 0-4 and 5-11 against 12-17; these are 3+ SPD groups assessed against a referent.
Age (3 levels), race/ethnicity (White referent vs several groups) and FPL income (4 levels) each have referent tests; sex has 2 levels and Census region is geography, not an SPD.

Footnotes say the p-values test 'intended group and corresponding referent group', with no omnibus or trend test; the blanket 'did not differ by race/ethnicity' sits under the same stated two-sided tests. The race n_groups of 7 counts the Hispanic total, which overlaps its subgroups (6 non-overlapping groups), a minor point.
